close_reason:
Landed: 17 new wiremock smoke tests across 4 files in crate-jmap-calendars-client/tests/:

- tests/calendar_smoke_tests.rs (extended): 3 new tests
  * calendar_set_on_destroy_remove_events_true_passthrough
  * calendar_set_on_destroy_remove_events_none_omits_field
  * calendar_changes_since_state_and_max_changes_passthrough
- tests/event_smoke_tests.rs (new): 7 tests covering
  CalendarEventGetParams, CalendarEvent/changes, CalendarEvent/query
  filter+sort+expandRecurrences, CalendarEvent/queryChanges,
  CalendarEvent/copy cross-account success.
- tests/event_notification_smoke_tests.rs (new): 6 tests covering
  CalendarEventNotification/get, /changes, /set (destroy-only with
  both None and Some inputs), /query with NotificationFilterCondition
  including the 'type' wire-key rename, /queryChanges.
- tests/participant_identity_smoke_tests.rs (new): 4 tests covering
  ParticipantIdentity/get, /changes, /set create round trip, /set
  destroy-only passthrough.

Each test independently mocks a spec-shaped response (oracle:
draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §3, §4, §5, §7) and asserts on BOTH the
captured wire request body and the deserialized typed response.

Also updated 6 dangling source-comment references to closed/nonexistent
trackers (JMAP-sc1b.64, JMAP-231o.8.1) across src/methods/{calendar,
event, event_copy, event_notification, event_parse, participant_identity,
principal_availability}.rs to either point at JMAP-uuoi.1 or, where the
coverage now actually exists, name the specific test that covers it.

Note on the JMAP-231o.8.1 edits: those references were technically out of
the bead's stated acceptance (which only listed JMAP-sc1b.64), but every
file already needed a JMAP-sc1b.64 edit on adjacent lines, and leaving the
JMAP-231o.8.1 references in place would have produced contradictory
comment blocks (sc1b.64 line saying 'covered' next to 231o.8.1 line saying
'tracked under follow-up bead'). Updated both for consistency.

Quality gates green:
- cargo test --workspace passes (4 new tests added, 13 across the 3 new
  test files, plus 7 in the extended calendar_smoke_tests.rs).
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.
- cargo fmt --all --check clean.

Sibling beads JMAP-uuoi.{2..7} (filed during this triage) propagate the
test-file layout and helper pattern to the 6 sibling extension-client
crates per the workspace canonical-template rule.
description:
Add wiremock smoke tests to crate-jmap-calendars-client/tests/ for the methods that lost vacuous-test coverage in JMAP-231o.8. This is the canonical bead of the per-crate decomposition; siblings cover mail-client, contacts-client, tasks-client, filenode-client, sharing-client.

Pattern: see crate-jmap-calendars-client/tests/availability_tests.rs::principal_get_availability_round_trip — wiremock setup + production call + body_json assertion. Each test ~40-60 LoC.

Methods needing new smoke coverage:
- calendar_set onDestroyRemoveEvents flag passthrough on wire
- calendar_event_get extra params (expandRecurrences / reducedParticipants / fetchCalendars / recurrenceOverridesBefore / recurrenceOverridesAfter / timeZone) passthrough
- calendar_event_query expandRecurrences flag + filter/sort serialization
- calendar_event_query_changes since_query_state passthrough + comparator serialization
- calendar_event_changes since_state + max_changes passthrough
- calendar_event_copy success path: cross-account create map with fromAccountId
- calendar_event_notification_set destroy-only enforcement (None vs Some(&['n1','n2']))
- calendar_event_notification_get / changes / query / queryChanges basic shape
- participant_identity_get / changes / set (incl. onSuccessSetIsDefault for /set)

Existing tests/ already covers: calendar_get, calendar_event_set basic create, calendar_event_parse notParsable, calendar_event_copy empty-creation-id guard, principal_get_availability. Do not duplicate; extend.

Acceptance:
- ~10-15 new wiremock-backed tests in tests/*.rs files (split into per-method-family files where sensible).
- cargo test -p jmap-calendars-client passes.
- The dangling source comments 'See JMAP-sc1b.64' in src/methods/{event_notification,event_parse,participant_identity,principal_availability}.rs are updated to point to this bead.
- README.md need not change for this bead.

Cookie-cutter rule (workspace AGENTS.md Canonical Templates): once this lands, the per-crate sibling beads under JMAP-uuoi mirror the file/test layout 1:1 to keep extension-client crates consistent.
